shared_or_similar_visual_information: The numerical notation 2 in both images.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The number 2 is listed as an element of the intersection of the two sets. Right image: The bottom segment from the lower-left corner to the vertical segment has length value 2.
Rationales: The left context gives the number the role of listed set element, while the right context gives it the role of geometric length.
